I just started going here on 8/11 and ever since then i have been going everyday. When i tell you the customer service is beyond amazing and the taste and quality of the product is so amazing! Stopped by for the first time and I actually really liked this place! The drinks were made exactly how I wanted them and tasted great. ❤️

The only disappointing part was that I ordered 3 drinks and was given a drink tray to carry them. As soon as I stepped out, the tray bent and my matcha fell. 😞 I went back inside and explained what happened, and he apologized and mentioned that they had gotten new cups and that they probably didn’t hold well in the trays.

I honestly thought he was going to offer to remake my matcha, especially since the tray had bent, but unfortunately I had to purchase another one. After I bought the replacement, he offered me a bag that holds two drinks while I carried the third one. I just wish I had been offered the bag from the beginning, especially since they were already aware that the new cups might not hold well in the trays.

Overall, I really did like the place and the drinks were great! I was just a little disappointed with how that situation was handled. I would still give them another try. ❤️

Boba Bean in Concord is an absolute gem. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted by an easygoing, genuinely friendly staff who make the whole experience feel relaxed and welcoming. Their service is consistently great without ever feeling rushed or forced.

The drinks are where Boba Bean really shines. Whether you’re grabbing a classic milk tea, trying one of their fruit teas, or going for a specialty coffee, everything is high-quality and full of flavor. You can really taste the care they put into every cup.

The shop itself is in a great, easy-to-find location—perfect for a quick stop or a chill hangout spot. It’s the kind of place you go once and immediately decide you’re coming back.

If you’re in Concord and want amazing boba, great coffee, and even better vibes, Boba Bean is the move. Highly recommend.

It’s such a treat having a local boba shop right nearby! The convenience alone is amazing—being able to grab a fresh drink before some grocery shopping is great. The place has such a cozy, welcoming vibe, and the staff were pretty awesome in making some suggestions when I couldn’t decide. It’s become my go-to spot for and my kids, whether I’m craving a classic honeydew milk tea or trying something new. I’m really glad to have this gem in the neighborhood! And when you get a chance ask about the secret menu
Fantastic for pick me up with a coffee or refresh with a boba tea bursting with flavor! Friendly staff is happy to recommend some of their favorites :)

From the moment I walked in, the vibe was impeccable — cozy lighting, chill music, super clean, and just the perfect spot to relax or catch up with friends. The atmosphere alone is worth 5 stars.
But the customer service? Next level phenomenal. The staff greeted me with genuine smiles, patiently explained the menu when I couldn’t decide (first-timer problems), and even gave me a perfect recommendation based on my mood. They were so kind, attentive, and made me feel like a regular on my very first visit.
And the drinks… oh my gosh. The honeydew boba was life-changing — perfectly chewy tapioca pearls, rich milky tea, just the right sweetness. I also tried their signature iced latte and it was hands-down one of the smoothest, most flavorful coffees I’ve ever had. Every sip was pure happiness.
This is officially my new favorite boba/coffee spot. If you’re in the area, do yourself a favor and stop by — you won’t regret it! Already planning my next visit. Thank you for the amazing experience! 🧋☕❤️
The drinks are amazing and delicious, and I would highly recommend getting some. Definitely my new favorite boba place highly addictive.

Boba Bean in Concord is an absolute gem. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted by an easygoing, genuinely friendly staff who make the whole experience feel relaxed and welcoming. Their service is consistently great without ever feeling rushed or forced.

The drinks are where Boba Bean really shines. Whether you’re grabbing a classic milk tea, trying one of their fruit teas, or going for a specialty coffee, everything is high-quality and full of flavor. You can really taste the care they put into every cup.

The shop itself is in a great, easy-to-find location—perfect for a quick stop or a chill hangout spot. It’s the kind of place you go once and immediately decide you’re coming back.

If you’re in Concord and want amazing boba, great coffee, and even better vibes, Boba Bean is the move. Highly recommend.

It’s such a treat having a local boba shop right nearby! The convenience alone is amazing—being able to grab a fresh drink before some grocery shopping is great. The place has such a cozy, welcoming vibe, and the staff were pretty awesome in making some suggestions when I couldn’t decide. It’s become my go-to spot for and my kids, whether I’m craving a classic honeydew milk tea or trying something new. I’m really glad to have this gem in the neighborhood! And when you get a chance ask about the secret menu

From the moment I walked in, the vibe was impeccable — cozy lighting, chill music, super clean, and just the perfect spot to relax or catch up with friends. The atmosphere alone is worth 5 stars.
But the customer service? Next level phenomenal. The staff greeted me with genuine smiles, patiently explained the menu when I couldn’t decide (first-timer problems), and even gave me a perfect recommendation based on my mood. They were so kind, attentive, and made me feel like a regular on my very first visit.
And the drinks… oh my gosh. The honeydew boba was life-changing — perfectly chewy tapioca pearls, rich milky tea, just the right sweetness. I also tried their signature iced latte and it was hands-down one of the smoothest, most flavorful coffees I’ve ever had. Every sip was pure happiness.
This is officially my new favorite boba/coffee spot. If you’re in the area, do yourself a favor and stop by — you won’t regret it! Already planning my next visit. Thank you for the amazing experience! 🧋☕❤️
